name: knowledge-base-management
description: Knowledge base management skills for collecting multi-source content into NotebookLM, querying NotebookLM notebooks, and generating study artifacts.

interface.shortDescription: 收集多源内容到 NotebookLM 并生成学习产物。
interface.longDescription: Knowledge Base Management packages joeseesun/qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm and PleasePrompto/notebooklm-skill as Codex skills. The imported skills help agents collect WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube links, podcasts, local documents, Office files, PDFs, EPUBs, images, audio, and search results into NotebookLM, then generate podcasts, slide decks, mind maps, quizzes, reports, flashcards, optional Feishu documents, or source-grounded answers from existing NotebookLM notebooks.
defaultPrompt: Use qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm to send this content to NotebookLM.
Use notebooklm to ask my saved NotebookLM notebook about this topic.
Turn this article into a NotebookLM podcast or slide deck.
